name: Perfect Game
summary:
Perfect Game is a free daily quiz about Nintendo games, played in the browser. Each day has three rounds: pick the title that sold the most copies, the one with the highest user score, and the one with the highest critic score. One pick per round, no second chance. Three correct picks make a Perfect Game.

The cards are drawn from a hand-curated database of more than 1,250 Nintendo and Nintendo-exclusive titles. Sales figures come from published publisher reports, scores from Metacritic. Everyone plays the same daily puzzle, and the result screen shows how the other players of the day voted, plus a generated cover mashup of the titles in play. An unlimited mode is available for practice.

No account, no download, no install. Available in German and English.

Perfect Game is part of n-puzzle.com, a hobby project run by a single person. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo. All game titles and trademarks belong to their respective owners.
